quest.title: Alan Smithee, Author of Fischl: Epilogue
quest.description: Now that you've learned Mr. Nine's secret, it's time to deliver the hidden royalties to Chang the Ninth...

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: That's right. Just channel Mr. Nine. How would he write this particular essay, hmm...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Chang the Ninth! We have something for you!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: What? Where did all this Mora come from!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: About that... So, um, the thing is... Right! Mr. Nine really admires your work, so he decided to fund your writing career!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Wait, what? So... channeling Mr. Nine actually worked!? I can't believe it!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Of course, for Chang the Ninth, wealth pales in comparison to his craft. The matter of Mora is swiftly forgotten as he puts pen back to paper. \n\nThus, you continue on back to Mondstadt...
